It is sponsored by [[Emirates (airline)|Emirates]] and known as the '''Emirates FA Cup''' for sponsorship purposes. The FA Cup is the main domestic cup competition for men's football teams in England. The qualifying competition began on 7 August 2026, with the tournament proper set to start on 7 November 2026. The [[2027 FA Cup final|final]] will be played at [[Wembley Stadium]], [[London]], on 22 May 2027. Eight-time winners and defending champions, [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]], will enter the competition hoping to appear in their fifth consecutive FA Cup Final. ==Teams, dates and regulations== The FA Cup is a [[Single-elimination tournament|knockout]] competition with 124 teams taking part from the first round proper, and all trying to reach the final at Wembley Stadium on 22 May 2027. The competition consists of the 92 teams from the Football League system (20 teams from the [[Premier League]] and the 72 in total from the [[EFL Championship]], [[EFL League One]] and [[EFL League Two]]) plus the 32 surviving teams out of 651 teams from the [[National League System]] that started the competition in the [[2026–27 FA Cup qualifying rounds|qualifying rounds]]. The six-round qualifying competition began with the extra preliminary round on 7 August 2026, with the fourth and final qualifying round kicking off on 17 October. ==First round== A total of 80 teams will play in the first round: 32 winners from the fourth qualifying round, 24 from [[EFL League Two|League Two]] (tier 4), and 24 from [[EFL League One|League One]] (tier 3). Ninth tier side [[Tadley Calleva F.C.]] (Combined Counties League Premier Division South) were the lowest-ranked team in the draw.
